note: Newest first. One entry per change to a skill or scheduled task. Written by whoever ships the change (Analyst for strategy, Architect for plumbing). Keep each field to one sentence.

changes.title: Leans sorted into Core, More and Noise tiers
changes.change: Every lean gets a tier: A Core (MM90, WIN, HR85, FO), C noise (CUSH, OUTLIFT, LSR, L5P, HR80, any Avoid), B the rest; tiers are recomputed weekly from each type's 30-day record and published as tiers.json, the Telegram run summary counts Core leans only, and the results message adds a tier hit % line.
changes.why: Mitch 24 Nov: 112 leans in a day is too many to read. Before 24 Nov the split was A 74.3% (35), B 60.1% (188), C 53.2% (158). Display only: every lean is still 0u and recorded.

changes.title: Renamed to bigboomy's NBA piggy bank
changes.detail: New name in the page header, browser tab and home-screen app (icon label: piggy bank). Matchups ahead rows now show the same seed and win-chance line as Still to come.

changes.title: One player, one name across bookies
changes.change: When bookies spell a player differently (Diabate / Diabaté, Day'ron / Day'Ron), all spellings now become one player, so he gets one set of leans and results count once.
changes.why: Mitch's 24 Nov manual run showed the same player listed twice with duplicate leans.

changes.title: Seed and win chance on games
changes.detail: Still to come rows and game cards show each team's conference seed and record, and the favourite's chance to win, marked market or est. Nothing shows when the slate files have no seed or win data.

changes.title: Conference seed and expected win % on every matchup
changes.change: Each game's matchup block now carries both teams' conference seed and record, plus an expected win %: from the market handicap once odds exist, otherwise from net ratings plus home court.
changes.why: Mitch 24 Nov: see the standings and who should win on the still-to-come list. Display only, nothing feeds a pick or lean.

changes.title: Windows scorecard shows the alone record
changes.detail: Each window can now show its alone record (picks where only that window fired) under its name. When the engine gives a promotion verdict, the scorecard uses it: Ready to promote, Passed but waiting on alone sample, or Passed but the alone record does not beat the price.

changes.title: Windows must earn promotion on their own nights
changes.change: A condition window is flagged ready to promote only if its full record passes (30+, P(beats) > 0.8) and its record on nights no other window fired also beats the price (10+ results, P(beats) > 0.5); under 10 it shows waiting on alone sample.
changes.why: Mitch 24 Nov, critic proposal: a window that only wins when another window also fires is a duplicate, not a second edge. The kill switch is unchanged.

changes.title: RET2-BLK and windows scorecard fix
changes.detail: Adds the RET2-BLK meaning, RET2 now reads Back for 1-3 games, and the windows scorecard reads hit, break-even and gap as percentages always, so a small gap like -0.4pp is no longer scaled up.

changes.title: Assists blocked for a few nights after a teammate returns
changes.change: When a rotation teammate came back 1-3 games ago and the player's assists ran 15%+ higher without him, assist overs can't be a staked pick or an MM90/HR80/L5P item: logged as a 0u lean tagged RET2:<name> AVOID. Points and rebounds stay display only. Switches itself off if it loses to doing nothing.
changes.aim: Mitch 23 Nov (critic: the Davion Mitchell case).

changes.title: Results message shows hit % only, leans first
changes.change: The nightly results message now opens with All (today's hits and %, plus the rolling 3-day %), then Leans, then Picks, then the best and worst lean type for the day. No break-even, pp, units or ROI.
changes.aim: Mitch 23 Nov: picks are rare, so leans get the attention.

changes.title: Scoreboard All block, WIN tier, RU-BLK and WIN-BLK
changes.detail: Scoreboard opens with All bets (picks plus every lean: last slate day and last 3 slate days as hits of settled), then leans, then picks, then each lean tier; adds the WIN tier fold, code meanings for WIN, WIN:<id>, RU-BLK and WIN-BLK, pending windows in the scorecard, and fixes the Record window defaulting to season.

changes.title: Condition windows: PTS-TOUGH, REB-OPPOUT, sweep candidates
changes.change: Points overs v a tough matchup (env <= 0.97) and rebound overs when an opposing key player is out each log the highest short rung ($1.20-1.34) as a 0u WIN lean tagged WIN:<id>. Windows the daily critic sweep starts apply automatically when they add 0u leans; a sweep window that would block picks waits for Mitch's OK. All switch themselves off if they lose to doing nothing.
changes.aim: Mitch 23 Nov: act on what the board scan finds, with the kill switch as the guard.

changes.title: v3.36 windows on the dashboard
changes.detail: Adds the FO tier (own fold and scoreboard row), a red Avoid pill on AVOID items, code meanings for FO, RET1, AVOID, RET2 and RU, the minutes-mixture figure beside PMM, and a Windows scorecard fold from windows.json that highlights switched-off, signal and ready-to-promote rows.

changes.title: RU block, RET1 on every pick stat
changes.change: When a player's last-3 minutes are 4+ above his L10 average (and no teammate is newly out), his overs can't be a staked pick or an MM90/HR80/L5P item: logged as a 0u lean tagged RU AVOID. RET1 now covers every pick stat, and a late-scratch re-run never surfaces an AVOID item. Both switch themselves off if they lose to doing nothing.
changes.aim: Mitch 23 Nov: act on the windows, not just log them (critic addendum).

changes.title: Window layer: RET1 block and FO REB/AST leans
changes.change: RET1: when a rotation teammate is back tonight after missing the last game and the player's stat ran 15%+ higher without him, overs on that stat can't be a staked pick or an MM90/HR80/L5P item (logged as a 0u lean tagged RET1:<name> AVOID). FO: when a 20+ minute teammate is out for the first time, the highest REB/AST rung at $1.20-1.34 is logged as a 0u lean. Every window and display flag keeps its own record from 24 Nov; an action window that loses to its counterfactual (15+ items, 6+ team-games, P < 0.2) switches itself off with a Telegram note.
changes.aim: Mitch 23 Nov (critic WINDOW-2026-11-23): returning players' impact should have been caught; no silent display flags.

changes.title: p_mm_mix calibration column
changes.change: Board and data.json (pmx) log a minutes-mixture P(over): the minutes model averaged over how actual minutes have varied from projection, fitted on the engine's own projections. Display and logging only.
changes.aim: Critic MM-MIX-2026-11-23 (Mitch's go-ahead).

changes.title: Tile layout for picks and leans
changes.detail: Each player stat is one row of tiles in fixed Shortest/Longer/Longest columns (line, $price, hit score badge, grey-to-green shade, solid PICK tag); lines under 7 show as outlined ghost tiles; tapping a tile opens what each code means with Took it / Pass inside, and the toast offers Undo.

changes.title: Starter badge on picks and leans
changes.detail: Shows Starter (4+ of last 5 starts), Starting (confirmed lineup) or Bench (confirmed not starting) beside the player; reads optional gs and lu fields from data.json and shows nothing until the pipeline adds them.

changes.title: Tap the ring to mark a pick or lean taken or passed
changes.detail: Each tap on the ring cycles taken, passed, no call; the ring stays as it is, and a green or amber bar plus a Taken / Passed pill show the call. Saves to the choices tab like Took it / Pass, now on leans too (needs the updated Apps Script); a pass locks at tip.

changes.title: Late returns re-run the game
changes.change: When a player who was OUT at the run is no longer OUT 10+ minutes before tip, the game is re-run like a late scratch: anything new is logged as a 0u LSR lean. Original picks and leans stand.
changes.aim: Mitch 23 Nov (Norman Powell).

changes.title: MM90 test extended to 120 when unclear
changes.change: If MM90 is neither confirmed nor rejected at 60 team-games, the same test runs again at 120 before Mitch decides.
changes.aim: Mitch 23 Nov.

changes.title: Calibrated minutes-model chance logged (p_mm_cal)
changes.change: The board file now also logs the minutes model's chance corrected per stat. At 90%+ the raw model claimed about 95% and landed about 89%; the corrected figure says about 90%. Logging only: MM90 still selects on the raw figure.
changes.aim: Mitch 23 Nov. Refit monthly.

changes.title: Rebound and assist picks logged at 0u
changes.change: A pick on rebounds or assists is now logged as a 0u lean flagged STAT0U, on the same rung. Points picks stake as before. Test tiers are unchanged.
changes.aim: Mitch 23 Nov (queued for 27 Nov, checked first). 13-22 Nov our REB/AST picks and leans: assists -23pp, rebounds -8pp v price; points -2pp. Re-stake when REB/AST get within 2pp of break-even over 30+ team-games.

changes.title: REB-ANC flag (display only)
changes.change: Rebound items against an opponent whose top rebounder takes 17.8+ boards per 48 get a REB-ANC flag. Nothing else changes.
changes.aim: Mitch 23 Nov (queued for 27 Nov). The proposed one-rung haircut was not shipped: against the price these rungs ran -5.4pp v -4.8pp otherwise, so the books already price it.

changes.title: L5P tier (0u test)
changes.change: New tracked tier shown as leans: for points, rebounds and assists, the highest best-held price at $1.50-1.99 that he went over in each of his last 5 games played. If another item already has that line, that item carries L5P-ALSO instead. Verdict at 60 team-games: confirm at break-even or better with the 80% range above -2pp; reject at 3pp or more under.
changes.aim: Mitch 23 Nov. Backtest 13-22 Nov: a perfect 10 of 10 ran about 10pp under its price (76 rungs); a perfect last 5 at $1.50-1.99 about level (107 rungs) against about -4pp for an average rung there. The perfect-10 pick rule is unchanged.

changes.title: Late returns flagged
changes.change: A player who was OUT at the run and is no longer OUT on ESPN before tip gets a Late return note on his game and a Telegram alert. The bets on that game were built with him out.
changes.aim: Mitch 23 Nov (Norman Powell). Alert and display only: no re-run, stake or rule change.

changes.title: Last 5 counts team games, missed games shown as a dash
changes.change: The last-5 boxes beside each bet are now his team's last 5 games; a game he did not play shows as a dash. The Last 5 games averages cover the games he played in that window and say how many he missed. A traded player's games before he joined are not counted as missed.
changes.aim: Mitch 23 Nov. Display only: the engine's hit-rate sample (last 10 games played) is unchanged.

changes.title: Late scratches struck through
changes.change: When a player with a pick or lean is ruled OUT between the run and tip, his name, line and odds are struck through with a Late scratch tag. Anyone with an item is now always on the late-scratch watch list.
changes.aim: Mitch 23 Nov. Display only: no stake, rule or record change (books normally void these).

changes.title: MM90 fold: results by stat
changes.detail: The MM90 fold now splits hit, break-even, gap and units by stat, with MM90-ALSO rungs (held by HR80, PIN or leans) shown apart and never counted in MM90; display only, the verdict stays on the whole tier.

changes.title: MM90 tier shown on its own
changes.detail: MM90 leans are kept out of the regular lean counts and record and get their own fold and scoreboard row with the pre-registered verdict; legend rows added for MM90, MM90-ALSO, PMM, BIGEDGE?, RET-ADJ and BK-, and the header names the three-book best price from v3.32.

changes.title: Return discount for a key teammate back (switched on)
changes.change: When a key teammate (top-3 scorer, top rebounder or top passer, 24+ min) plays tonight, every recent game the player had without him is scaled down by 75% of the player's own with/without difference, shrunk to a league prior. Points, rebounds and assists only; nothing changes when that teammate is out. The RET-ADJ flag shows when 3 or more of the sample games are affected.
changes.aim: Mitch 22 Nov via the critic (2 seasons, 1,476 games: padded samples clear the 80% line 4-8pp less often). Replay 13-22 Nov: about break-even, too few bets to judge.

changes.title: Rebound and assist estimates with a key player out, refitted
changes.change: Starting estimates for a teammate's lift when the key rebounder or passer sits: rebounds x1.24 to x1.15 (starters) and x1.31 to x1.25 (bench); assists x1.36 to x1.28 (starters). Points unchanged. Used by the shadow model and the return discount.
changes.aim: Mitch 22 Nov via the critic (same 1,476 games).

changes.title: Best price across the books Mitch holds
changes.change: Every pick, lean and tier item now takes, logs and settles at the best price for that line across Pointsbet, Ladbrokes and Sportsbet. A BK- flag names the book when it isn't Pointsbet.
changes.aim: Mitch 22 Nov via the critic: the best price is worth about 2pp on its own (179,122 settled rungs, 13-22 Nov).

changes.title: Pinnacle as the starting probability
changes.change: Where Pinnacle has a two-way line for the prop, the engine's probability starts from Pinnacle's fair chance at that line instead of the local price less a margin. With no Pinnacle line nothing changes.
changes.aim: Mitch 22 Nov via the critic: Pinnacle is the only signal better calibrated than the local price.

changes.title: BIGEDGE? caution
changes.change: An item whose edge over the price is more than 10 points gets a BIGEDGE? flag, and that edge no longer pushes it up the order. Big disagreements with the market were the worst buckets (-7 to -20pp).
changes.aim: Mitch 22 Nov via the critic. Display and ordering only.

changes.title: MM90 tier (0u test)
changes.change: New tracked tier beside HR80: the highest-priced rung at $1.20-1.29 (best held price) where the minutes model gives 90%+. If another item already has that line, that item carries MM90-ALSO instead. Verdict at 60 team-games: confirm at break-even or better with the 80% range above -2pp; reject at 3pp or more under.
changes.aim: Mitch 22 Nov via the critic: the only positive pocket on the board (+3.4pp, 156 props), a candidate rather than proof.

changes.title: Robot mascot: new app icon and header
changes.change: An original 8-bit robot (blue, visor, waving, basketball at the hip) is the new home-screen and notification icon, and sits beside the dashboard title.
changes.aim: Mitch 21 Nov. Display only. On iPhone, delete and re-add the home-screen app to pick up the new icon.

changes.title: Losses in red
changes.change: A lost bet now shows red on its result chip and on its line (and the actual it settled on); they were amber or plain.
changes.aim: Mitch 21 Nov. Display only.

changes.title: Matchups ahead: tomorrow's games from the resolve run
changes.change: Below the games, a Matchups ahead section lists every scheduled game still to tip that the slate hasn't analysed yet. Tap one for its Matchup tab: records, season team stats with ranks and edge bars, what each defence allows, expected pace and the ESPN injury list. It appears after the 18:07 resolve, before any odds exist; once the slate run analyses a game, its full card takes over.
changes.aim: Mitch 21 Nov. Display only; data from schedule.json game.mx and game.inj (pipeline resolve, from 21 Nov).

changes.title: Key teammate back pill
changes.change: Next to the key-teammate-out pill, a blue 'back' pill names a top-3 teammate who missed most of his recent games and plays tonight (the RET code), so his share of the usage may drop.
changes.aim: Mitch 21 Nov. Display only; names from data.json game.ret (pipeline, from 21 Nov runs).

changes.title: Last 5: key teammate out (amber) and overtime (dot)
changes.change: A last-5 number has an amber outline when one of his team's top two in that stat sat out that game, and a dot when it went to overtime. The numbers are now the real box score (OT games were shown scaled to 48 minutes). The player fold names who was out and which games went to OT.
changes.aim: Mitch 21 Nov: see at a glance whether a clear came from extra minutes or opportunities. Display only; data from data.json l5x (pipeline l5tags).

changes.title: Scoreboard shows last 3 and last 7 days only
changes.change: Each scoreboard row (picks and every 0u tier) shows two lines, last 3 days and last 7 days (W-L, hit %, units), counted back from the latest settled day. Season totals, direction tags and verdict progress bars moved off the scoreboard; they stay in each section's breakdown.
changes.aim: Mitch 21 Nov. Display only.

changes.title: Last 5 reads oldest to newest
changes.change: The last-5 number strip on each bet now reads oldest to newest, left to right, so the most recent game is on the right. Data unchanged.
changes.aim: Mitch 21 Nov. Display only.

changes.title: Light/dark toggle
changes.change: Button beside the title switches light and dark; the choice is saved on that device. With nothing saved the page still follows the phone or browser setting.
changes.aim: Mitch 21 Nov: phone and browser are dark, he wants the dashboard light. Display only.

changes.title: Rings keep their colour; hit count moves into the player fold
changes.change: Settled rings keep their chance colour (grey-out reverted, Mitch). The 'L10 x/10' count under each ring is gone; each player's fold now lists every line with 'cleared in x of his last 10 games', above the last-5 averages when those are in the data (box5 and l5 start with the next slate). The fold is titled 'Recent form' until last-5 data exists.
changes.aim: Display only (Mitch, 20 Nov).

changes.title: Lost lines keep their normal colour
changes.change: A lost line no longer turns orange; it stays the normal ink colour with the actual number in brackets underneath. Only a win turns the line green. Push and void stay grey.
changes.aim: Display only (Mitch, 20 Nov).

changes.title: Re-score fixes: honest lean tally, grey settled rings, killed rows dimmed, dark-mode contrast
changes.change: Killed OUTLIFT no longer counts in the status-line lean tally or the best-leans strip. Once a bet settles its ring turns grey, so on a settled row colour means only the result. The last-10 count reads 'L10 7/10' so it isn't mistaken for a rating. Killed OUTLIFT rows are dimmed with a 'killed' tag. Settled game cards show 'Final · leans W-L' instead of the tip time. Bets/Matchup toggle is compact. Dark mode: pressed tabs and stat chips now pass 4.5:1. Mark my picks button is 44px. Tier glosses no longer repeat the code beside them.
changes.aim: Display only, from the 20 Nov re-score (28/40). No gate, tier, stake or price change.

changes.title: Chance /10 key removed; minor fixes from the re-score
changes.change: The Chance /10 column label and ring colour key are gone (Mitch); the last-5 over/under key shows once per page when there is data. Each bet button reads as one clear sentence to screen readers. After jumping from the best leans, a Back to best leans button returns you to the row you tapped. Killed OUTLIFT no longer counts in a game's lean total: the header and fold show it separately as record only.
changes.aim: Display only. No gate, tier, stake or price change.

changes.title: Results on the line, bigger names, scoreboard direction, desktop columns
changes.change: Settled lines turn green (won) or orange (lost) with the actual number in brackets underneath; the W/L pill is gone. Player names 22px. Status line follows the night (set, coming in, results are in) and counts leans; settled best-leans strip shows its W-L. Header says when picks were posted; footer says when the record was read. Scoreboard rows show break-even and a direction tag (Too early under 15, above or below break-even; HR80 against its 80/76 target), bar coloured to match. Tier codes get a one-line meaning in the tap detail. Stats tiles hidden on 0-pick days, next-slate line moved below the games. Two columns at 1100px+ (slate left, scoreboard right).
changes.aim: Display only, from the 20 Nov re-score critique and Mitch's mock. No gate, tier, stake or price change.

changes.title: Last 5 games dropdown per player
changes.change: Each player tile has a 'Last 5 games' dropdown with last-5 and season per-game averages: MIN, PTS, REB, AST, 3PM-A, FGM-A, FG%, FTM-A, STL, BLK, TO; tonight's bet stats shaded, minutes 4+ under season in amber.
changes.aim: Mitch 20 Nov (averages only); data from the ESPN game log the pipeline already fetches (data.json box5). Display only.

changes.title: Dashboard critique fixes: best leans on top, clearer rings, thinner rows
changes.change: On a 0-pick day a Best leans tonight strip (top 5 by hit chance) sits above the games and the KPI tiles shrink to one line; ring header reads Chance /10 with the last-10 count under the ring and a colour key; tier chip and 'tap for codes' move into the tap detail; Mark my picks and Projected totals move below the slate; 44px tap targets, one chevron style, contrast fixes.
changes.aim: Mitch 20 Nov ('run them all', after the 25/40 impeccable critique): decide faster on a phone on quiet nights. Display only: no gate, tier, stake or price changes.

changes.title: VERDICT retired
changes.change: The pipeline stops writing the plain-English verdict: new context rows leave verdict, v_score, v_text and verdict_ver blank; rows already written are kept.
changes.aim: Mitch 20 Nov ("Retire it"): the hit /10 ring does the job; golden test test_v331_verdict_retired_golden.

changes.title: Verdict badges and sentences removed
changes.change: The Worth a look / Mixed / Caution badges, their one-line sentences and the per-game verdict counts are gone from the cards; bets within a player now sort by hit chance, highest first.
changes.aim: Mitch 20 Nov: the hit /10 ring now does that job. The pipeline still logs the verdict to the context tab, so the frozen VERDICT test keeps running unseen.

changes.title: Ring shows hit chance out of 10
changes.change: Each bet's ring now shows the engine's hit chance out of 10 (1/price + edge, e.g. 7.8 = about 78%), coloured green at 8.5+ to red under 7; the last-10 count moved into the tap detail.
changes.aim: Mitch 20 Nov: confidence out of 10 based on hit rate; on 4,172 settled board rungs the engine's estimate was calibrated (71.4% vs 70.8%) while the last-10 count barely predicted hits. Display only.

changes.title: Dashboard redesign: box score with hit-rate rings
changes.change: New look (condensed scoreboard numbers, team-colour edge per game); each bet is one aligned row: a last-10 ring coloured green to red, a coloured stat pill, the last 5 actual numbers (tinted when over the line), line and odds; Matchup adds against-the-spread and overs/unders records.
changes.aim: Mitch 20 Nov ('Yes, build it', design A with rings): faster to read on a phone. Display only: no gate, tier, stake or price changes (freeze to 27 Nov holds); last 5 shows from the next slate run.

changes.title: 30 team-game rule for tier verdicts
changes.change: Every 0u tier verdict (HR80, PIN, LSR, VERDICT) now also needs 30+ distinct team-games and shows an 80% CI clustered by team-game; the review also reads the verdict test from the context tab.
changes.aim: Mitch 20 Nov ('Yes, 30 team-games', critic C-2026-11-20-2): several rungs on one team's night are one piece of evidence, not several.

changes.title: OUTLIFT killed
changes.change: No new OUTLIFT items (or LSR-OUTLIFT from re-runs) from v3.30; the 52 logged rows stay as a closed record.
changes.aim: Mitch 20 Nov ('Kill now', critic C-2026-11-20-1): 48 settled at -11.43u, so the test could no longer pass.

changes.title: HR80 replaces HR85
changes.change: The hit-rate tier now takes only the best-priced perfect Pointsbet rung at $1.20-1.29 (was $1.20-1.39), flagged HR80, 0u; HR85 rows keep their own closed record.
changes.aim: Mitch 20 Nov (via the critic): target 80% hit; CONFIRM at 80%+ over 60 settled from 30+ team-games, KILL under 76% over 60.

changes.title: Clearer Pinnacle wording
changes.change: Verdict and scout notes now say Pinnacle rates his chance X pp below (or above) what the price needs, instead of 'prices it worse than we get'.
changes.aim: Critic 20 Nov: the old wording read like a good deal when it was a warning.

changes.title: OUTLIFT 7/10 gate removed
changes.change: OUTLIFT goes back to the highest-priced $1.20-1.59 rung at or under the main line, whatever its hit rate; the v3.28 gate never ran on a slate.
changes.aim: Mitch 20 Nov: two nights showed 7/10+ OUTLIFT items 9-11 against 25-16 for the rest; the OUTLIFT record carries on unbroken.

changes.title: When tonight's absentees sat
changes.change: Matchup shows, for each player out tonight, how his teammates did against their usual numbers in the games he missed this season; scout notes mention it when the player has 2+ such games.
changes.aim: Mitch 20 Nov: record whose numbers got the rise when a player is out (absence ledger, data only).

changes.title: Scout notes fold away
changes.change: Each player's scout note sits behind a 'Scout note' toggle, collapsed by default.
changes.aim: Mitch 20 Nov: less text on screen until wanted.

changes.title: OUTLIFT needs 7 of his last 10
changes.change: An OUTLIFT item now needs its rung to have hit in at least 70% of the sample (7/10); the highest-priced band rung that passes is logged, otherwise none.
changes.aim: Mitch 20 Nov: stop OUTLIFT logging players at 5/10 or worse; the OUTLIFT record restarts at v3.28 for its verdict.

changes.title: Scout note per player
changes.change: Each player gets 2-3 plain sentences built from the card's own facts: who is out, what the opponent gives up, form against the line, minutes, fatigue and Pinnacle.
changes.aim: Mitch 20 Nov: scout-report style reasons, facts only (no AI or news).

changes.title: Each player shows once, one tile per bet
changes.change: Bets are grouped by player as tiles (top edge coloured by verdict); tap a tile for its verdict, numbers and folded codes, and an amber pill names the key teammate who is out.
changes.aim: Less scrolling and noise: Mitch 20 Nov, the same player appeared several times and the codes were noisy.

changes.title: Cleaner layout: compact game cards, one scoreboard, one guide
changes.change: Game cards show verdict counts in the header and switch between Bets, Matchup and Injuries & line, with leans ordered Worth a look first; one Scoreboard (picks plus every 0u tier with progress to its verdict) replaces the record and tier sections, which now sit in one Full record fold; Legend, How to read and What changed are merged into one Guide.
changes.aim: Less scrolling and one place for each job; rollback is git checkout pre-layout-c -- index.html.

changes.title: Plain-English verdict on every pick and lean; Matchup edge bars
changes.change: Each pick and lean shows a Worth a look / Mixed / Caution badge and one sentence built from its codes and tonight's matchup (pipeline 5587016); the Matchup tab gets an Edge column whose arrow points to the better team and whose bar shows the size of the rank gap.
changes.aim: Read a card in plain English and spot matchup edges at a glance; display only, the verdict is logged and tested (look vs caution, 5pp over 100 settled) but never moves a stake.

changes.title: Legend of every card code
changes.change: A collapsible Legend table explains every flag and code on the game cards (51 entries in 8 groups: stake, lean kinds, 0u tiers, sample and minutes, teammates, matchup, market, columns and results); tapping a code on a card opens the legend at that row.
changes.aim: Mitch can read any card without remembering what each code means; display only.

changes.title: Leans show W/L on the game card
changes.change: After the resolve, each lean row (including HR85, PIN, OUTLIFT and re-run items) shows a W/L/PUSH/VOID pill with the actual stat, read from the Sheet's leans tab, the same way picks already did.
changes.aim: Mitch can see at a glance how the leans went; display only, leans stay 0u and no rule changes.

changes.title: Matchup tab on every game
changes.change: Each game has Bets / Matchup buttons; Matchup shows records (incl. ATS and over-under against the DraftKings closing line from ESPN), season team stats with league ranks, what each defence allows per 100 possessions, tonight's pace and line, and key players freshly out.
changes.aim: Give Mitch an LP-style matchup page next to the bets; display only, nothing in it changes a pick, lean or stake.

changes.title: Late-scratch auto re-run (0u LSR items)
changes.change: When a watched player turns OUT at least 10 minutes before tip, the tick re-runs that game and logs anything new to it as a 0u lean flagged LSR plus what it would have been (LSR-PICK, LEAN, HR85, PIN or OUTLIFT); the original picks and leans are never changed.
changes.aim: Find out whether acting on late scratches pays before any staking: KILL if flat ROI is below 0 after 40 settled, CONFIRM above +5% (Mitch, 18 Nov).

changes.title: OUTLIFT teammate-out tier (0u)
changes.change: When a key player (top-3 scorer, top rebounder or top passer) has a key teammate freshly ruled out, the highest-priced Pointsbet alt rung at $1.20-1.59 at or under his main line is logged as a 0u lean flagged OUTLIFT with its own record.
changes.aim: Test the critic's finding that key-player alt rungs hit 76% vs 73% needed in that spot: KILL if flat ROI is below 0 after 60 settled, CONFIRM above +5% (Mitch, 18 Nov).

changes.title: Display flags: OPP-OUT, REB-OPP, MAIN-U, BEST (no pick effect)
changes.change: Picks and leans now show OPP-OUT:<roles> when the opponent has key players freshly out, REB-OPP on rebounds when the opponent's top rebounder is out (the market overreacts there), MAIN-U+x when a held book's main-line under pays 2pp or more over Pinnacle's fair price, and BEST-<book>@<price> when Ladbrokes or Sportsbet pays more than Pointsbet for the same line.
changes.aim: Show the new context where the bet is read (Mitch, 18 Nov); display only, no change to picks, leans, tiers or stakes.

changes.title: Live context data on every item (data only)
changes.change: Minutes model, with/without lift, opponent key players freshly out, Pinnacle fair price and the best price across all books now show on every pick, lean, HR85 and PIN row and go to a new Sheet tab 'context'; the board also logs steals, blocks and the combo props, and each game carries a season team table with league ranks.
changes.aim: Move everything out of shadow into the live datasets (Mitch, 18 Nov); nothing here changes a pick, lean, tier or stake.

changes.title: PIN Pinnacle-anchor tier (0u)
changes.change: Each player/stat's alt rung at Pointsbet, Ladbrokes or Sportsbet priced $1.20-3.00 that pays 4pp or more over Pinnacle's margin-free price is logged as a 0u lean flagged PIN with its own record; every pick, lean and HR85 rung also shows PIN+ or PIN- for whether Pinnacle agrees.
changes.aim: Test whether soft-book prices that lag the sharp line make money: KILL if flat ROI is below 0 after 100 settled, CONFIRM above +5% (Mitch, 18 Nov).

changes.title: HR85 hit-rate tier (0u)
changes.change: Each player/stat's best-priced Pointsbet rung at $1.20-1.39 whose matchup-adjusted sample (8+ games) cleared the line every time, with the line at most 70% of the average, is logged as a 0u lean flagged HR85 with its own record on the dashboard, outside the near-miss leans.
changes.aim: Test Mitch's 85%-at-$1.20+ goal: on the fixed 13-16 Nov board this rule went 21-3 (88%, +2.73u flat); KILL under 83% over 40, CONFIRM at 85%+ over 40, then Mitch decides on staking.

changes.title: Threes back to board-only
changes.change: Threes (3PM) are no longer picked or leaned; they stay logged and graded on the whole board every night.
changes.aim: Only 5 graded threes props sat in our price band, so they go back to data-only until there are 60 to judge (critic C-3).

changes.title: Board results use the adjusted sample
changes.change: The nightly whole-board CSV now counts hits, perfect samples, edge and cushion on the matchup-adjusted values the engine actually picks on (raw counts kept alongside); 13-16 Nov were re-graded.
changes.aim: Make board-based rule tests (HR85, best price, the scout) describe the live rule rather than the pre-v3.20 one.

changes.title: A tier: staked picks need 6pp edge
changes.change: A perfect-sample pick is only staked when its stated edge is 6.0pp or more (A tier); a perfect pick with 3-6pp edge is kept as a 0u lean flagged THIN (B tier) on the same rung and tracked in the leans section.
changes.aim: Live since 7 Nov perfect picks with 6pp+ went 13-3 (+2.92u) and thinner ones 3-3; the replay of 9-16 Nov drops only 1 of 14 picks, so it guards against thin edges without cutting volume much.

changes.title: Opponent matchup adjustment
changes.change: Each game in a player's sample is rescaled for tonight's opponent and expected pace (what the opponent allows of that stat per 100 possessions), shrunk toward league average while team data is thin; picks show an Opp line and an MU+x% flag, and threes (3PM) are now logged and graded on the whole board but not yet picked.
changes.aim: Stop treating a hot run against soft defences as form; backtest 9-16 Nov changed little (11-3 vs 10-3) and the effect grows as team samples fill in.

changes.title: Fresher prices, underdog flag, whole-board results
changes.change: Picks wait one 5-min tick when a fresh odds copy is minutes away; a DOG7 flag (no stake effect) marks players whose team is a 7+ point underdog; every rung on the board (Pointsbet, Sportsbet, Ladbrokes) is now graded nightly.
changes.aim: Stop picking on half-hour-old prices and build ~100 graded rungs a night to test rule ideas properly.

changes.title: Perfect samples only
changes.change: A pick is only staked when the player cleared the line in every game of the sample (e.g. 10/10, 9/9); a pick with any miss is kept as a 0u lean flagged MISS on the same rung.
changes.aim: Season to date perfect samples went 46-17 (+5.38u) and one-miss picks lost; expect around break-even until the whole-board data confirms it.

changes.title: Pipeline moved to the home server
changes.change: Picks now come from deterministic Python on the home server (no AI per run), checked every 5 min from 2am to 3pm so each game is picked about 90 min before tip; a closing price only counts if it comes from a newer board than the pick's. Same v3.18 rules, with these approved readings: depletion counts rotation players only, ROLE? is a flag only, half-star stakes round down, no EARLY flag, no projected total or Opp.
changes.aim: Same rules, reproducible picks, tested before going live.

changes.title: Player-prop odds move to HaterPicks
changes.change: Slate ladders and market totals, the closing-price capture and the ladder log now come from HaterPicks' free NBA feed (one call per run returns the whole board, refreshed every 30 minutes); totals settle from ESPN final scores. The Odds API stays as a per-run fallback while its credits last.
changes.aim: Keep the system running after the Odds API quota runs out (~14 Nov) at no cost, with Sportsbet prices available for v3.19.

changes.title: Opponent line back on picks
changes.change: The opponent allowance (e.g. 'Opp 112.54 (9–/25)', with its up/down arrow) shows again under each pick and lean; it was left out when the cards became tables on 10 Nov. It's hidden when the slate sends no value.
changes.aim: Restore the matchup context Mitch uses when reading a pick.

changes.title: Leans collapsed under each game
changes.change: Each game's leans now sit in a collapsed row under its picks, titled 'Leans (n) · near-misses, tracked not bet'; opening it explains they just missed a pick rule (cushion, price cap or looser test) and are staked at 0u.
changes.aim: Keep the real picks front and centre while leaving the near-misses one tap away.

changes.title: No limits on picks per game or per player
changes.change: The 3-picks-per-game, 2-per-player and 3u-per-game caps are removed, so every pick that clears the gates is bet at its full stake; a game with 4+ picks is flagged STACK for information only.
changes.aim: With the cushion gate and 1.85 cap the slate makes about 1–3 picks a day and the caps weren't binding; Mitch wants every qualifying pick, accepting that picks in one game can lose together.

changes.title: Injuries, back-to-backs and coverage sent to the dashboard
changes.change: Every analysed game now also carries out / q (each team's Out and Questionable/Doubtful players from the official injury report), b2b (teams on a back-to-back) and cov (the coverage counts and skipped players) for the dashboard; picks are unchanged.
changes.aim: Architect request §9 item 14: show each game's injury and schedule context on the dashboard without any Sheet or script change.

changes.title: Game cards as mini tables, with who's out
changes.change: Each game card now has two small tables: game info (Out, Doubtful / Q and B2B per team, the total with prices, coverage) and the picks with their leans (shaded, 0u) in one table with odds, hit, edge and stake. Until the slate sends structured injury fields, the info table shows the slate's note text instead.
changes.aim: Bring back a clear view of who's out and make each game readable at a glance.

changes.title: Safer-rung display retired
changes.change: The slate no longer computes or shows a 'safer rung' on 1.80+ picks (it never actually populated, and the 1.85 cap left it covering only 1.80–1.85 picks); the slate now also checks that every 2-star pick is staked at 0.25u.
changes.aim: Remove a step that silently never ran; stepping down a rung can now be analysed after the fact from the alt-ladder log.

changes.title: Alt-ladder log: every Pointsbet rung recorded
changes.change: Each slate run now saves its alt-odds fetch and logs every Pointsbet alt rung (line:price, Over and Under) for every player and stat of the games it analysed into the Sheet's new `ladders` tab, one row per ladder. No extra Odds API requests.
changes.aim: Give the Fable price-map and rung-policy study real prices for every rung (about 14 slates for a coarse calibration, 30 for the map).

changes.title: Model totals settle the same night
changes.change: The resolve now settles a game's total the same evening it is recorded, if the score feed already has it final. Before, each day's totals settled the following evening.
changes.aim: Totals results land the same night as the props.

changes.title: Leans 6–8 Nov backfilled; leans failures now alert
changes.change: The leans tab was never published, so the resolve could not read it and skipped leans every night. 14 leans from 6–8 Nov were recovered from data.json history and settled from box scores. A leans failure now sends a push notification instead of one quiet output line.
changes.aim: Make the lean test possible and stop a silent gap recurring.

changes.title: 2-star picks staked at 0.25u
changes.change: The skill said 0.5u for 2-star picks in one rule and 0.25u in another; it now says 0.25u everywhere, and the Monday review splits gated picks into perfect vs one-miss samples to test 'perfect samples only' as the next rule.
changes.aim: Remove the stake ambiguity on the lowest-confidence picks and line up the next test (perfect samples 73% +4.9u vs one-miss 52% −30u for the season).

changes.title: No staked picks priced above 1.85
changes.change: A rung can only be a staked pick if its price is 1.85 or shorter; rungs that pass everything else at a longer price become CAP leans (0u), so the killed picks are still tracked.
changes.aim: Picks at 1.86+ went 4/22 (18% vs 51% implied, −14.3u) because the engine's assumed bookmaker margin is about half the real one at long prices; judge on CAP lean results and staked ROI over the next 50 picks.

changes.title: Z-margin and teammate-out flags on every pick (shadow, under test)
changes.change: Every pick and lean now carries Z<z> (how many standard deviations the line sits below the player's average) and TMO / TMO-Q / RET when a top-3 scoring teammate is out, questionable or just returning; they never change a pick, and the Monday review tests them at n≥30.
changes.aim: Fable's 2,607-game study found hit rate climbs from 58% at z<0.5 to 89% at z≥1.5 and teammates gain 6pp when a top scorer sits; test whether that beats the price on our own bets before any rule.

changes.title: Picks need a cushion: alt at most 70% of the player's average
changes.change: A rung can only be a staked pick if its alt line is at most 0.70 × the player's average over the same sample games; rungs that pass everything else but not this become CUSH leans (0u), and every pick and lean carries a C<ratio> flag (e.g. C0.62).
changes.aim: Picks with that cushion went 29/36 (81% vs 67% implied, +7.3u) and the rest 95/182 (52%, −31u); judge on the first 50 gated picks by hit vs implied and CLV.

changes.title: Each game shows how many players were checked
changes.change: Every analysed game now carries a Coverage line (in the run output and the game context on the dashboard) counting the players and player-stats with a Pointsbet alt ladder that were evaluated, and naming any skipped with the reason; picks are unchanged.
changes.aim: Make it visible that every player is reviewed and nothing is silently skipped, e.g. a name that fails to match ESPN.

changes.title: Overtime games no longer inflate a player's sample
changes.change: When a game in a player's sample went to overtime, its minutes, points, rebounds and assists are scaled back to 48 minutes (one OT ×0.906) before hits are counted, and the pick or lean is flagged OT-ADJ; bets still settle on the real box score including overtime.
changes.aim: Stop overtime-assisted hits making a 4/5 player look 5/5 at the edge of the +3pp bar (Zion's 7/8 on 7 Nov contained three overtime games and was really 6/8).

changes.title: Player game logs now come from ESPN, with a freshness check
changes.change: Hit rates are now counted from ESPN game logs (full current season, newest 10 games, minutes included) instead of StatMuse, any player who sat his team's last game is flagged DNP-LAST, and the slate re-counts every sample before saving; StatMuse is a flagged fallback only. Today's (7 Nov) picks were deleted and rebuilt on the new logs.
changes.aim: StatMuse was returning short, stale samples (Maxey shown 5/5 when he was 8/9, Derrick White 4/4 when he was 6/8 and below the edge bar), so picks were being made on the wrong games.

changes.title: Minutes-trend flag on picks and leans (shadow, under test)
changes.change: Every pick and lean whose player has 7+ games this season now carries MT+ when his last-5 minutes are 1.5+ above his last 10, or MT- when 1.5+ below; it never changes a pick, and the Monday review compares flagged against unflagged results.
changes.aim: Test on our own bets whether a rising or falling minutes role predicts results beyond the price (two seasons of box scores showed a 6–7pp hit-rate gap), before ever making it a rule.

changes.title: More leans on quiet days, flagged QUIET
changes.change: On a Melbourne date with fewer than 4 NBA games, leans use m = 15 instead of 20 (so 4/5 and 5/6 samples can show) and every lean that day carries a QUIET flag; staked picks stay at m = 30 every day.
changes.aim: Give quiet days some tracked 0u data without lowering the staked bar, and keep QUIET leans separable so they can be judged on their own.

changes.title: Leans tracked separately (0u)
changes.change: From the 6 Nov slate (nba-session v3.9) each game can carry leans: rungs that pass at m=20 but not m=30. The 18:07 resolve records them from data.json into the Sheet's new `leans` tab and settles them from the same box scores. A collapsed 'Leans (0u)' section shows hit rate against market-implied, record and notional 1u units for 7d / 30d / season. Leans are never staked and never touch the cohort, stats, record, units or hit rate.
changes.aim: Judge whether m=20 rungs earn their keep once n≥30, without them muddying the real record.

changes.title: Stricter picks again, plus a tracked 0u lean tier
changes.change: The shrink weight goes back from 15 to 30, so staked picks again need a near-perfect sample (e.g. 5/5 or 6/6 at 1.40–1.50), and rungs that pass only at m = 20 are shown as LEAN at 0u in a separate leans list that is never staked, recorded in the cohort or sent to Telegram.
changes.aim: v3.8 went 33/57 (57.9%) against ~66% implied, −6.63u, almost all from one-miss samples (17/36); this restores quality while still measuring whether those quieter samples carry any signal.

changes.title: Today's slate first; today's games listed from the first run
changes.change: Today's slate moved to the top. Copy buttons removed. Projected totals and model totals collapsed. From the first slate run (02:07) the slate lists today's games from the schedule, each marked with when its picks are due; the previous day's games are cleared. A day with no games shows 'No NBA games today'.
changes.aim: See what's on today at a glance, without yesterday's games hanging around.

changes.title: Resolve moved to 18:07 so late games settle the same night
changes.change: The nightly resolve now runs at 18:07 instead of 17:07, because a game is only settled 3h15 after tip and 14:10–14:40 tips were missing the 17:07 run and waiting a full day.
changes.aim: Every game's results, Telegram summary and record update land the same evening.

changes.title: Evening results posted to the Telegram group
changes.change: Each 17:07 resolve posts one Telegram message to the group with every settled pick (✅/❌, line, odds, actual), the day's W-L and units, the 7d/30d/season record and tomorrow's first tip; failures still go to Claude push privately.
changes.aim: See results and the next-day heads-up in the same place as the picks.

changes.title: Pick alerts now go to Telegram
changes.change: Each slate run that makes picks sends one Telegram message to @NBAboomybot with every game, tip and pick (line, odds, hit rate, stars, stake, safer rung), built by a hash-pinned script; Claude push is now only the fallback if Telegram fails.
changes.aim: Get the full pick list on the phone the moment it's made, without opening the dashboard.

changes.title: Model totals tracked as notional 1u bets
changes.change: Every analysed game's projected and market total (with Pointsbet over/under prices from 2 Nov) is recorded in a separate `totals` tab, settled from free final scores including overtime, and shown in a collapsed Model totals section with record, units, ROI and hit rate by window, gap bucket and side; the 22 Oct–1 Nov Notion log is shown separately at an assumed 1.91.
changes.aim: See whether the projected-total lean beats the market, kept apart from the prop record.

changes.title: Market total prices kept for the totals tracker
changes.change: Each analysed game now also records the Pointsbet Over and Under prices at the market total (mkt_o, mkt_u) from the totals call the slate already makes, at no extra Odds API cost; picks and the totals row are unchanged.
changes.aim: Score every model totals lean as a notional 1u bet at the real price, so the separate totals tracker shows what the model would have done.

changes.title: Next slate line on the dashboard
changes.change: Today's slate now shows the next game day's first tip, game count, last tip and first slate run, from a schedule.json the 17:07 resolve refreshes each evening via the free events call; the status banner now follows the 02:07 start.
changes.aim: Know at a glance when tomorrow's picks will start arriving without waiting for the evening notification.

changes.title: Every game included, whatever the tip time
changes.change: The early-morning cut-off is removed: the slate now runs hourly from 02:07 and capture from 03:48, so games tipping as early as about 04:00 Melbourne time get picks and a closing price, and the evening heads-up counts every game.
changes.aim: Stop skipping early weekend and holiday tips now that Mitch wants all games covered.

changes.title: Evening heads-up for tomorrow's games
changes.change: Every 17:07 run now sends one notification that ends with tomorrow's first tip, game count, last tip and the time of the first slate run, even when nothing needed settling.
changes.aim: Let Mitch know each evening when the first picks will arrive.

changes.title: Five-game samples can now qualify
changes.change: The shrink weight drops from 30 to 15 pseudo-games, so a player's 5 current-season games count for 25% of the estimate instead of 14% and a 4/5 or 5/5 record can pass the +3pp test.
changes.aim: Stop early-season slates going blank (2 Nov had none) while keeping the price as the main anchor; the review watches whether predicted hit rate drifts above actual.

changes.title: Player logs now come from the right season
changes.change: StatMuse names seasons by the year they end, so current-season logs now use 2027 and a 2026 table is treated as last season.
changes.aim: Make sure picks are judged on this season's games, not last season's.

changes.title: Slate and capture start two hours earlier
changes.change: The slate now runs hourly from 06:07 (was 08:07) and analyses games tipping from 06:37, and capture runs from 06:48 (was 08:48), still at minute :48.
changes.aim: Cover early tips such as 07:40 games, which the 08:07 start skipped.

changes.title: Each game analysed once, 30–150 minutes before its own tip
changes.change: The slate now runs hourly from 08:07 to 13:07 and analyses only games that tip within 150 minutes, at least 30 minutes away and not yet done today, with one totals call per run that has games, and capture now runs hourly at :48 from 08:48 to 14:48.
changes.aim: Catch early tips and fresher injury news game by game, while skipping games before 08:37 when Mitch can't bet them.

changes.title: Ready for hourly per-game slate runs
changes.change: Each slate run now merges its games into the day's dashboard file instead of replacing it, reports which games are already done today, and capture prices each pick once in its last 2–70 minutes before tip.
changes.aim: Let picks be made closer to tip, game by game, without losing earlier games or pricing the close twice.

changes.title: Every game on the slate is analysed
changes.change: The 4-game limit is removed, so the slate prices every game and cuts games only when the Odds API quota can't cover them plus a 50-request reserve for closing-odds capture.
changes.aim: Stop missing qualifying picks on big nights now that the stricter v3.5 test filters for quality instead of a game limit.

changes.title: Max 3 picks per game, no session cap
changes.change: Each game now allows at most 3 picks (was 5), the 8u session cap is removed because the per-game caps already limit a session to 12 picks, and any pick a cap trims is dropped instead of being logged.
changes.aim: Cut stacked exposure to one game's pace and blowout risk, and keep the record to picks the engine actually stands behind.

changes.title: Hit rates recalibrated toward the market price
changes.change: Each rung's probability now leans 75% on a price-adjusted market estimate (bookmaker margin assumed to rise from 0% at 1.50 to about 22% at 1.95), and a pick needs at least +3pp over the break-even price instead of +5pp over a margin-free price.
changes.aim: Close the gap between the 81% hit rate the model claimed and the 56% it delivered, which should mean fewer, shorter-priced picks and 1.80+ only on near-perfect samples.

changes.title: Picks, closes and results now recorded straight to the Google Sheet
changes.change: All three tasks write the Sheet through one hash-pinned script and check the Sheet's own totals after every write; Notion and record.json are no longer written.
changes.aim: One reliable record that the dashboard and the weekly analyst review read directly, with no copying between systems.

changes.title: Safer rung on 1.80+ picks
changes.change: Every pick priced 1.80 or longer now shows the next rung down priced 1.40–1.79, with its own hit rate; display only, not logged as a pick.
changes.aim: Make a higher-hit-rate alternative visible on long prices, and track whether stepping down would have paid.

changes.title: Resolve no longer overwrites closing prices
changes.change: Close odds and CLV are now owned by the capture task; resolve only marks a still-blank close as 'no close', and runs on Melbourne time.
changes.aim: Protect the closing-line data needed to judge whether picks beat the market.

changes.title: Closing-odds capture fixed
changes.change: A parsing bug had blanked every odds response, so 91% of picks had no closing price; capture now runs hourly before tip and asks only for markets with picks.
changes.aim: Get closing-line value (CLV) on every pick — the fastest honest signal of whether the model has an edge.
